description: The SlideServiceItemEditorWindow itself: the dark-theme XAML layout (keyed OWC styles, merged OwcDesignSystem.xaml) plus the thin code-behind and the two small picker modals (presentation + template). Depends on FEAT-001 (consumes ServiceItemAudio.Resolve and SlideAutoAdvanceMap, and the new ServiceItem fields). Not yet routed into OperatorWindow — that is FEAT-003 — but it must compile against WorshipPlayer.UI. The window operates on a deep-cloned working copy, defers all persistence/rename to Save, raises RemoveRequested (and nothing else) for remove, and keeps live-link integrity (Select sets SlidePresentationId only; never snapshots name/content).
steps: Create WorshipPlayer.Presenter\Views\Slides\SlideServiceItemEditorWindow.xaml following SlideEditorWindow.xaml precedent: a Window that merges pack://application:,,,/WorshipPlayer.Presenter;component/Themes/OwcDesignSystem.xaml in Window.Resources and uses KEYED StaticResource styles only (OwcButtonBase, OwcBlueButton, OwcTextBox, OwcPanelBorder, OwcTextSecondaryBrush, OwcDarkComboBox, OwcSlider). Width~760 Height~780, MinWidth/MinHeight sensible, WindowStartupLocation=CenterOwner, Background=#0F1117, FontFamily=Segoe UI. Body is a ScrollViewer with sections top->bottom: (1) Header DockPanel — left: large bold name TextBlock + pencil Button (OwcButtonBase/compact) that toggles an inline OwcTextBox + confirm; right: 'Remove service item' (OwcButtonBase), 'Close' (OwcButtonBase), 'Save and close' (OwcBlueButton, x:Name so IsEnabled can bind to dirty). (2) Slides card (OwcPanelBorder): bold linked-presentation name TextBlock + 'Select' button. (3) Background media card: 'Source' ComboBox (OwcDarkComboBox). (4) Auto-advance card: 'Go to next slide after' ComboBox + 'When complete' ComboBox; a delay TextBox/panel shown only for 'Time Delay'; a target-item ComboBox shown only for 'Specific item'. (5) Settings row: two side-by-side cards — Transitions (OwcSlider range 0-3000 + value label) and Audio (ListBox of paths with per-row remove 'x', a '+' OwcBlueButton, and a 'No audio files added' empty-state TextBlock in OwcTextSecondaryBrush). (6) Stage Display Template card: a dark style-preview tile (Border showing template Name + font/alignment descriptor), a label ('No template selected' default), a 'Select' button and a 'Clear' affordance.

Create WorshipPlayer.Presenter\Views\Slides\SlideServiceItemEditorWindow.xaml.cs. Constructor signature exactly: `public SlideServiceItemEditorWindow(ServiceItem item, IReadOnlyList<ServiceItem> allItems, ISlidePresentationService slidePresentationService, IMediaLibraryService mediaLibraryService, ITemplateService templateService)`. SYNCHRONOUS ctor does ONLY: InitializeComponent; deep-clone _working via JsonSerializer round-trip using a window-local _cloneJsonOptions that carries ONLY `Converters = { new JsonStringEnumConverter() }` (NO WriteIndented, NO WhenWritingNull — it must preserve nulls for an in-memory clone); capture _live=item, _allItems, the three services; set _suppressDirty=true. Subscribe Loaded.

In the Loaded handler (async) run ALL awaited population under _suppressDirty: resolve + show the linked presentation name (GetByIdAsync; on null show 'Linked presentation unavailable' and disable the rename pencil for the linked case); enumerate media via GetByTypeAsync(MediaLibraryType.Image) + GetByTypeAsync(MediaLibraryType.Video) and build the Source items (None first; a read-only 'Current: <type>' sentinel auto-selected when BackgroundType is SolidColor/Gradient; one row per Image/Video library item carrying its MediaLibraryItem; a transient 'Current: <filename>' row when BackgroundType is Image/Video but MediaPath matches no library FilePath); build the specific-item target list from _allItems excluding the current item, each label = ServiceItemDisplayName.ResolveDisplayName(it, it.SlidePresentationId is null ? null : await slidePresentationService.GetByIdAsync(it.SlidePresentationId)); resolve the template tile from StageTemplateId via GetByIdAsync. Preselect every initial control value here. Clear _suppressDirty ONLY after all awaits complete, and assert _isDirty==false at the end.

Implement dirty tracking: private bool _isDirty flipped true by every user change handler (TextChanged, SelectionChanged, ValueChanged, audio add/remove, rename confirm) but guarded by `if (_suppressDirty) return;`. Bind/drive Save-and-close IsEnabled from _isDirty (set false on open).

Implement the two Auto-advance ComboBoxes using SlideAutoAdvanceMap for load/save; grey/disable the 'When complete' ComboBox whenever 'Go to next slide after' == 'Disabled' (use SlideAutoAdvanceMap.WhenCompleteEnabled); show the delay field only for 'Time Delay' and the target ComboBox only for 'Specific item'.

Implement the Audio list backed by ServiceItemAudio.Resolve(_working) on open; '+' opens Microsoft.Win32.OpenFileDialog with Filter = "Audio|*.mp3;*.wav;*.m4a;*.aac;*.flac;*.ogg|All files|*.*" and appends the chosen path verbatim; per-row 'x' removes. Transitions slider two-way to _working.TransitionTimeMs (0-3000).

Implement rename (pencil) DEFERRED to save: for a live-linked item store _pendingPresentationName (update header display immediately) and set _isDirty — no service call now; for a non-linked item write _working.Title and set _isDirty. Reject blank/whitespace (keep prior name).

Implement the two pickers as small owned modal Windows (or one reusable ListPickerDialog) that ALSO merge OwcDesignSystem.xaml: presentation picker lists ISlidePresentationService.GetAllAsync() by Name and returns the chosen id (Select sets _working.SlidePresentationId ONLY — no content/name snapshot); template picker lists ITemplateService.GetAllAsync()/GetBuiltInTemplatesAsync() and returns the chosen SlideTemplate id. Degrade to an empty list if enumeration throws (log via Debug.WriteLine).

Expose `public event EventHandler? RemoveRequested;` and `public ServiceItem? Result { get; private set; }`. The Remove button handler raises RemoveRequested and does NOTHING else (no Result, no DialogResult, no Close, no manager call). Close/X discards (no copy-back, no deferred rename applied).

Implement Save-and-close: (1) apply any deferred linked-presentation rename via GetByIdAsync -> set Name -> UpdateAsync, wrapped so a failure shows a non-modal MessageBox ('Failed to rename the presentation: {msg}') and skips only the rename; if GetByIdAsync returns null, skip the rename. (2) Map the two Auto-advance dropdowns via SlideAutoAdvanceMap into _working.AutoAdvanceSettings (create/populate a ServiceItemSettings when a real after-condition or non-default destination is chosen; leave AutoAdvanceSettings null for the canonical Disabled+Do-nothing off state; whenever a settings object is created/updated set TransitionFadeTimeMs = _working.TransitionTimeMs). (3) Map the Source selection into _working.BackgroundType/MediaPath/MediaType per design Gap #3 (None nulls BackgroundType + clears MediaPath; the 'Current' sentinel writes nothing; a library row sets the three fields). (4) Write _working.AudioAttachments from the list (null when empty) and keep AudioAttachmentPath = AudioAttachments?.FirstOrDefault() ?? "". (5) Copy the ENUMERATED edited field set from _working back onto _live IN PLACE (SlidePresentationId, BackgroundType, MediaPath, MediaType, TransitionTimeMs, AudioAttachments, AudioAttachmentPath, StageTemplateId, AutoAdvanceSettings, and Title only for a non-linked rename); never touch Id/Order/Subtitle/Notes/DurationMinutes/ThemeId/ForegroundType/Slides/Song+Scripture fields. (6) Set Result=_live, DialogResult=true.
acceptance_criteria: SlideServiceItemEditorWindow.xaml/.xaml.cs compile as part of WorshipPlayer.UI; the window merges OwcDesignSystem.xaml and uses only keyed OWC styles (no inline-brush copy of OperatorWindow's rule).

On open with no edits, Save-and-close is disabled; every initial programmatic selection (Source incl. the Current sentinel, both auto-advance dropdowns, template) happens under _suppressDirty so _isDirty is false after population.
Select changes SlidePresentationId only (no name/content snapshot); the Slides card shows a safe fallback when the linked presentation is missing.
'When complete' is greyed when 'Go to next slide after' is 'Disabled'; the delay field shows only for 'Time Delay'; the target item dropdown shows only for 'Specific item'.
The Audio card shows 'No audio files added' when empty and lists resolved entries (legacy single path migrated as the first entry via ServiceItemAudio.Resolve); '+' adds, per-row 'x' removes.
RemoveRequested is raised only by the Remove button and the window sets neither Result nor DialogResult in that handler; Result is non-null only after a successful Save.
verification: Run: dotnet build WorshipPlayer.UI/WorshipPlayer.UI.csproj -c Debug  (from the worktree root) — expect Build succeeded with the new window + pickers compiled.
Run: dotnet test  — expect the full suite (FEAT-001 tests included) still green; no model/helper regressions introduced by the window.
findings:
DONE. Build (WorshipPlayer.UI -c Debug) clean (no warnings on the new files) + full `dotnet test` suite (810 tests) green.

NEW FILES (WorshipPlayer.Presenter\Views\Slides\):
  - SlideServiceItemEditorWindow.xaml / .xaml.cs — the editor (class WorshipPlayer.Presenter.Views.Slides.SlideServiceItemEditorWindow : Window). Merges OwcDesignSystem.xaml, keyed OWC styles only.
  - ListPickerDialog.xaml / .xaml.cs — ONE reusable owned modal list picker used for BOTH the presentation and template pickers (also merges OwcDesignSystem.xaml).

FEAT-003 ENTRY-POINT CONTRACT (for OperatorWindow wiring):
  CONSTRUCTOR (exact signature):
    public SlideServiceItemEditorWindow(ServiceItem item, IReadOnlyList<ServiceItem> allItems, ISlidePresentationService slidePresentationService, IMediaLibraryService mediaLibraryService, ITemplateService templateService)
    Pass the live CurrentServiceOrder.Items as `allItems` (modal, so no defensive copy). Set Owner = operatorWindow.
  REMOVE EVENT (exact name/type): `public event EventHandler? RemoveRequested;`
    The Remove button handler raises RemoveRequested and does NOTHING else (no Result, no DialogResult, no Close, no manager call). Host owns closing: subscribe, set removed=true; win.DialogResult=false; (do NOT call win.Close() in addition — setting DialogResult on a modal window closes it). Then bool saved = win.ShowDialog() == true. removed and saved are mutually exclusive.
  RESULT: `public ServiceItem? Result { get; private set; }` — non-null ONLY after a successful Save-and-close (also sets DialogResult=true). Close/X discards (DialogResult=false, Result stays null).
  SAVE copy-back: on Save the window ALREADY copies the enumerated edited fields back onto the passed-in live `item` IN PLACE (SlidePresentationId, BackgroundType, MediaPath, MediaType, TransitionTimeMs, AudioAttachments, AudioAttachmentPath, StageTemplateId, AutoAdvanceSettings; Title only for a non-linked rename) and ALREADY applies the deferred linked-presentation rename via ISlidePresentationService.UpdateAsync. So after ShowDialog()==true the host only needs: SaveServiceOrderAsync -> PrimeSlidePresentationCacheAsync -> RefreshServiceOrderList -> RefreshSlideSections. On the removed branch the host runs its existing remove/save/refresh idiom (nothing was copied back).

IMPLEMENTATION NOTES honored: window-local _cloneJsonOptions carries ONLY JsonStringEnumConverter (no WriteIndented, no WhenWritingNull — preserves nulls for the in-memory clone); _suppressDirty stays true across the ENTIRE awaited Loaded population and is cleared only after all awaits (Debug.Assert _isDirty==false at the end); Select sets _working.SlidePresentationId only; audio via ServiceItemAudio.Resolve + OpenFileDialog filter \"Audio|*.mp3;*.wav;*.m4a;*.aac;*.flac;*.ogg|All files|*.*\"; auto-advance via SlideAutoAdvanceMap (WhenComplete disabled when After==Disabled, delay field only for Time Delay, target ComboBox only for Specific item; AutoAdvanceSettings left null for the canonical Disabled+Do-nothing off state; TransitionFadeTimeMs kept in sync with TransitionTimeMs when a settings object is created). Pickers degrade to an empty list (Debug.WriteLine) if enumeration throws.

NOTE: the window is NOT yet routed into OperatorWindow (that is FEAT-003) but compiles into WorshipPlayer.UI.
